A little detective outing in Roath this weekend 🧡

St Margaret’s Church has a free children’s quiz trail during Open Doors:

🗓 Saturday 19 September: 12.30–5.30pm
🗓 Sunday 20 September: 2–5.30pm
📍 Waterloo Road, Roath, CF23 5AD

No booking needed. Our pick for curious 5–12s with a grown-up; the organiser doesn’t give an age limit for the quiz.

There’s accessible church entry through the porch. The tower climb is adults only, so keep this a church-and-quiz plan for the children.

Programme: https://cadw.gov.wales/open-doors-st-margarets-church-roath
More Cardiff family plans: https://donext.co.uk/
